verdict.rationale: AMD documents expanded MXFP6 and MXFP4 datatype support on the MI355X, and the ROCm docs provide deployment recipes for the vLLM and SGLang inference stacks. An independent benchmark reports decode throughput for MI355X at TP8, which corroborates that LLM serving works in practice. missing for 10: explicit FP8 documentation for this part, llama.cpp support evidence, and MI355X-specific (rather than generic ROCm) serving-stack guidance.
